SEARCH
Package it.unipd.search

Class ElasticsearchClient_Search

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.search.ElasticsearchClient_Search
@Component public class ElasticsearchClient_Search extends Object
Spring-managed component providing a high-level abstraction over the official Elasticsearch Java API client.

This class is responsible for:

  • Initializing and configuring a connection to an Elasticsearch cluster
  • Executing full-text search queries over one or more indices
  • Mapping Elasticsearch search hits to application-level Document objects

The client connects to an Elasticsearch node using the REST transport layer and the Jackson JSON mapper. The connection endpoint is currently configured to target a containerized Elasticsearch instance.

The search logic uses a multi_match query, boosting relevance for a primary field (e.g. document title) while also searching a secondary field (e.g. main content).

This component is thread-safe and can be safely shared across concurrent requests, as the underlying ElasticsearchClient is designed to be thread-safe.

  • Constructor Details

    • ElasticsearchClient_Search

      protected ElasticsearchClient_Search()
      Creates a new elasticsearchClient_Searcher and initializes the underlying ElasticsearchClient.

      The constructor builds a low-level RestClient, wraps it in an ElasticsearchTransport using a JacksonJsonpMapper, and finally creates the high-level API client.

      The constructor is protected to restrict uncontrolled instantiation to the same package or subclasses.

  • Method Details

    • searchDocuments

      public List<Document> searchDocuments(List<String> indexName, String field1, String field2, String queryText) throws IOException
      Executes a search query on the specified Elasticsearch index and returns the matching documents.

      The query uses a multi_match strategy, assigning a higher boost to the primary field (the document title) than the main_content.

      The search is executed against two fields and the textual query is provided verbatim to Elasticsearch.

      Only documents with a non-null source are included in the result list. Metadata such as document score and ID are intentionally ignored.

      must not be null
      Parameters:
      indexName - the name of the index to search in
      field1 - the document field on which the query is executed with a *3 boost
      field2 - the document field on which the query is executed
      queryText - the textual query value
      Returns:
      a List of Document instances representing the sources of the matching Elasticsearch documents
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while communicating with Elasticsearch
